 accepted=[m for a in audits for m in a['modules']]

 if label!='g3' and finals:
  assert sorted(finals[-1]['result']['accepted_owners'])==sorted(accepted),(label,'final/audit differs')
 all_accepted.extend(accepted)
 results[label]={'root':str(root),'final_results':finals,'audit_receipts':audits,'accepted_owners':sorted(accepted),'owned_declarations':sum(a['owned_declarations'] for a in audits),'public_declarations':sum(a['public_declarations'] for a in audits),'normal_receipts':[str(p.relative_to(base)) for p in sorted((root/'normal').rglob('NORMAL_PASS.json'))],'whole_P1_complete':False}

 files.extend(p for p in sorted(parent.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix not in {'.olean','.ilean','.o','.pyc'})
